records.name: The Petey Greene Program at Penn
records.summary: Penn students who tutor people in local correctional facilities, one on one or in small groups, to help them reach their academic goals.
records.what_you_do: Tutors support people inside correctional facilities with their studies. Joining takes an application, and the group holds general body meetings for interested students.

first_step.how: Email the group to ask about joining, or come to a general body meeting. Joining requires an application.
first_step.basis: The directory says an application is required before joining.

records.notes: Directory marks INACTIVE, but the program site lists stories whose web addresses carry 2026 dates, the newest dated 2026/10/7. The stories are about the Philadelphia program, not only this chapter. The site also says all interested people may apply to volunteer; this record keeps the Penn club as students only. The directory's first-meeting line gives a weekday and month but no year, so it is not used.

records.name: Umoja
records.summary: The umbrella group for Black student organizations at Penn. It brings member groups together on shared goals and a common calendar.
records.what_you_do: Coordinates its member groups and runs programs open to the whole Penn community. Students usually get involved by joining a member group's executive board, and UMOJA's own board applications open each late November.

first_step.how: Join a member group's executive board. UMOJA's board applications open in late November.
first_step.basis: Board seats need an application, though the group's programs are open to Penn students.

records.notes: Directory marks INACTIVE, but the group's site shows a funding total for the 2025 to 2026 academic year. That is the only dated item and it is a stat, not an event or post, so status is probably_active rather than active. No month is written. Board applications are the only join path listed.

records.name: Volunteer Income Tax Assistance at Penn (VITA @ Penn)
records.summary: Penn students who prepare free tax returns for Philadelphia residents each spring, working with the Campaign for Working Families.
records.what_you_do: Students help residents file their taxes for free during tax season. The club takes new students through a fall application.

schedule.text: Tax help runs every spring during tax season.

cost.text: The tax help is free for residents.

first_step.how: Students apply through the club's fall application, which closed on September 18, 2026. Email the club to ask when the next round opens.
first_step.basis: A fall application comes first, and the club's own text calls it an application.

records.notes: Directory marks INACTIVE, but the club's own entry names a Fall 2026 application due end of day September 18, 2026. That is dated 2026 activity inside the last 12 months. The month 2026-09 is the deadline month, since the posting date is not shown. The partner Campaign for Working Families is a separate organization and its site was not checked. The directory's application flag holds an unclear value, so the first-step text relies on the club's own wording. The application deadline has passed as of this check.

records.name: West Philadelphia Sanctuary
records.summary: A group that creates free, welcoming gathering spaces in West Philadelphia so people can meet, build connections, and feel less alone.
records.what_you_do: Works with local spaces across West Philadelphia and at Penn to bring people together. Interested people start with the group's interest form.

cost.text: The community spaces are free, according to the club's description.

first_step.how: Fill out the group's interest form, which the club's entry links. The entry also links an application form.
first_step.basis: A form or application comes first, and no public schedule is listed.

records.notes: Directory marks INACTIVE. The club's own description names a 2026 award with no month written. That is the only dated item, so status is probably_active. The directory lists no website; its links are forms and social pages, which were not opened or used as sources. Founded 2024 per the directory. The description says the work reaches the broader community, not only Penn students, so audience is public.

records.name: Wharton Energy Conference
records.summary: The Wharton energy club's yearly conference on climate tech, energy finance, and business in the energy industry. Students and professionals attend together.
records.what_you_do: Attend a one-day conference with talks through the day and an evening happy hour, or join the club as a student member. The 2026 conference is on Friday, October 30, 2026, at Convene in Philadelphia, and tickets are sold online.

schedule.text: One day, Friday, October 30, 2026, with talks and an evening happy hour.

first_step.how: Buy a conference ticket through the link on the club's site. To join the club, students apply through Penn Clubs.
first_step.basis: Anyone can buy a ticket and attend, while club membership needs an application.

records.notes: Directory marks INACTIVE, but the conference page names the conference on October 30, 2026, with the year written twice. The directory says the conference is aimed at graduate and MBA students, but the page sells tickets publicly, so audience is public. The directory email is hidden, so only the website is listed. The page footer names the Wharton Energy Club; the Penn Clubs entry is named for the conference.

records.name: Wellness Student Coalition
records.summary: Penn's student wellness umbrella group. Its committees plan wellness events, speak up for student mental health, and help fund student-led programs.
records.what_you_do: Members join a committee such as events, publicity, advocacy, or finance and help with its work. The group meets weekly, and the time asked is flexible.

schedule.text: Committee meetings are weekly. The club's site lists a Wellness Week 2026 page, and the event is held every year.

first_step.how: Fill out the club's interest form or email the group to ask about joining a committee.
first_step.basis: Any student can fill out the interest form, and the club says it is always taking new committee members.

records.notes: Directory marks INACTIVE. The club's site, reached through the upennwellness.com redirect to its WordPress site, names a Wellness Week 2026 page in its menu. No month is written, so no last_sign_of_life is set. The directory's application flag says yes, but the club's own text describes an interest form, so newcomer friendliness is 3. The founding year 2015 is history, not activity. Footer credits are not used as dates.

notes: Recheck of 20 Penn clubs that the directory marked INACTIVE. The status rules would call those probably_active, but the batch rule holds them back, so the orchestrator may want to decide. Where a page gives only a year, no last_sign_of_life month is written.
